details: picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

cna.title: Coder before 2.34.7 IP Spoofing via X-Forwarded-For Header

descriptions.value: Coder before 2.34.7 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in the ExtractRealIPAddress middleware that trusts the leftmost, client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value instead of the client IP appended by a reverse proxy. Attackers can send forged X-Forwarded-For values through appending proxies to bypass per-IP rate limits on login, one-time passcode, and password validation endpoints, enabling brute-force attacks, and to falsify IP addresses recorded in audit logs.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder before 2.34.7 IP Spoofing via X-Forwarded-For Header

cna.title: Coder before 2.34.2 User Enumeration via Login Placeholder Hash

descriptions.value: Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a user enumeration vulnerability because userpassword.Compare() substitutes a placeholder hash derived from the string "hunter2" when a stored password hash is empty. Unauthenticated attackers can submit logins with the password "hunter2" and distinguish HTTP 403 from 401 responses to enumerate valid accounts and reveal the authentication provider of SSO-only users.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder before 2.34.2 User Enumeration via Login Placeholder Hash

cna.title: Coder before 2.34.2 Stored HTML Injection via Appearance Settings

descriptions.value: Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability because the ApplicationName and LogoURL appearance settings are rendered into HTML output without sufficient escaping. Attackers with the Owner role can store HTML markup in these settings that renders in the Coder dashboard and in SMTP notification emails sent to other deployment users.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder before 2.34.2 Stored HTML Injection via Appearance Settings

cna.title: Coder 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 Open Redirect via Workspace App Proxy

descriptions.value: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability in handleAPIKeySmuggling that allows attackers to redirect users externally via unsanitized r.URL.Path values. Attackers can craft links on trusted workspace app subdomains with paths beginning with double slashes, which become scheme-relative redirects to attacker sites for phishing.

descriptions.description: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 Open Redirect via Workspace App Proxy

cna.title: Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 Information Disclosure via Workspace ACL Endpoint

descriptions.value: Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in the GET /api/v2/workspaces/{id}/acl endpoint, which checks only workspace read access and then fetches group members using an elevated system context. Authenticated users granted workspace use access can query the endpoint to harvest group members' emails, login types, status, and last-seen and creation timestamps.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 Information Disclosure via Workspace ACL Endpoint

cna.title: Coder 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 Cross-Organization File Disclosure via DownloadFile RPC

descriptions.value: Coder from 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the provisioner daemon DownloadFile gRPC handler that allows authenticated provisioner daemons to download other organizations' cached Terraform module archives. Attackers with an org-scoped provisioner key and a known file UUID can retrieve module source code exposing infrastructure topology or embedded secrets.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 Cross-Organization File Disclosure via DownloadFile RPC

cna.title: Coder 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 Authorization Bypass via User-Level ACL in RBAC Policy

descriptions.value: Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the acl_allow rule of coderd/rbac/policy.rego, which does not verify organization membership for per-user ACL entries, and organization member removal does not scrub those entries. Authenticated users removed from an organization can keep accessing previously granted org-scoped resources such as templates and workspaces via the API.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 Authorization Bypass via User-Level ACL in RBAC Policy

cna.title: Coder before 2.35.4 Credential Theft via Workspace Proxy Hostname Prefix Match

descriptions.value: Coder before 2.29.20, 2.33.0 before 2.33.12, 2.34.0 before 2.34.8, and 2.35.0 before 2.35.4 contains an improper hostname validation flaw in GetWorkspaceProxyByHostname whose SIMILAR TO pattern performs a prefix match, so any domain that is a string prefix of a workspace-proxy access URL is trusted as a proxy. Attackers owning such a domain can lure an authenticated victim to a crafted /api/v2/applications/auth-redirect link, capture the redirected application_connect API key, and replay it to access the victim's workspace apps.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder before 2.35.4 Credential Theft via Workspace Proxy Hostname Prefix Match

cna.title: Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 Information Disclosure via Agent /debug/manifest

descriptions.value: Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 has an unauthenticated agent debug HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:2113 whose /debug/manifest handler returns the full agent manifest, including template-provided environment variable values. A lower-privileged Unix user or process in the same workspace can query this endpoint to read credentials such as cloud keys or registry tokens.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 Information Disclosure via Agent /debug/manifest

cna.title: Fleet before 4.83.0 Denial of Service via Unbounded Gzip Decompression

descriptions.value: Fleet before 4.83.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory by sending gzip-compressed request bodies. Attackers can send small, highly compressed requests with Content-Encoding: gzip to unauthenticated endpoints that expand during decoding, crashing the entire Fleet instance.

descriptions.description: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Fleet before 4.83.0 Denial of Service via Unbounded Gzip Decompression

cna.title: Fleet before 4.89.0 Unauthenticated DoS via Apple MDM Enrollment Plist Parsing

descriptions.value: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment property list parsing that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a crafted binary plist payload of about 150 bytes to the enrollment endpoints, triggering exponential allocation or infinite recursion that exhausts CPU and memory.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Fleet before 4.89.0 Unauthenticated DoS via Apple MDM Enrollment Plist Parsing

cna.title: Vikunja 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 Permissive CORS Policy Trusting Localhost Origins

descriptions.value: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 contains a permissive CORS configuration that trusts every localhost and 127.0.0.1 port with credentials, even when service.publicurl is set. Attackers controlling a page on any localhost port can send a credentialed request to the token refresh endpoint and read the returned bearer JWT to take over the logged-in user's account.

descriptions.description: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 Permissive CORS Policy Trusting Localhost Origins

cna.title: Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 Incorrect Authorization in Link Share Deletion

descriptions.value: Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows project members with Write permission to delete admin-tier link shares because the delete permission check reads an unloaded share object. Attackers can send DELETE requests to the v1 or v2 projects shares endpoints with sequential share IDs to revoke admin links and invalidate existing share sessions.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 Incorrect Authorization in Link Share Deletion

cna.title: Vikunja 2.6.0 Broken Access Control via Inherited Project Permissions

descriptions.value: Vikunja 2.6.0 contains a broken access control flaw in getProjectAccessForUser (pkg/models/project_access.go), which resolves a user's effective project permission as the maximum over the project tree, silently overriding explicit lower-permission shares on sub-projects. A collaborator with write access on a parent project but read-only access to a child project can modify the child project's tasks and content.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 2.6.0 Broken Access Control via Inherited Project Permissions

cna.title: Vikunja 0.22.0 before 2.7.0 Improper Access Revocation via Webhooks

descriptions.value: Vikunja 0.22.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper access revocation vulnerability that allows removed collaborators to keep receiving project data through webhooks they created. Former collaborators keep receiving task titles and descriptions through their webhook, including content created after their access was revoked.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 0.22.0 before 2.7.0 Improper Access Revocation via Webhooks

cna.title: Vikunja 1.0.0-rc0 before 2.7.0 Cross-Tenant Task Position Writes via Saved Filter Creation

descriptions.value: Vikunja from 1.0.0-rc0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in RecalculateTaskPositions that allows authenticated users with zero accessible projects to write task_positions rows for all tasks instance-wide. Attackers can delete their Inbox after repointing default_project_id, then create empty-filter saved filters to persist cross-tenant references and amplify writes for denial of service.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 1.0.0-rc0 before 2.7.0 Cross-Tenant Task Position Writes via Saved Filter Creation

cna.title: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.7.0 WebSocket Authentication Ignores Session Revocation

descriptions.value: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper session validation vulnerability that allows attackers to keep WebSocket access after revocation because handleAuth never checks the JWT sid claim against the sessions table. Attackers holding a stolen access token can open or maintain connections to /api/v2/ws after session deletion or TOTP enrollment, continuing to receive the victim's notification.created pushes, including comment, task and project content.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.7.0 WebSocket Authentication Ignores Session Revocation

cna.title: Admidio before 5.0.16 Information Disclosure via rss/links.php Weblinks Feed

descriptions.value: Admidio before 5.0.16 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view role-restricted weblinks because rss/links.php omits the category_view role-visibility filter. Attackers can request the weblinks RSS feed for an organization to retrieve link names, URLs, descriptions, categories, and creator names from restricted LNK categories.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio before 5.0.16 Information Disclosure via rss/links.php Weblinks Feed

cna.title: Admidio 5.0.11 before 5.0.16 Broken Access Control via inventory_data.php

descriptions.value: Admidio from 5.0.11 before 5.0.16 contains a broken access control vulnerability in modules/inventory/inventory_data.php that allows authenticated users to bypass the inventory_module_enabled restriction. Attackers with any valid login can request the DataTables JSON feed to read every inventory item and keeper names, even when the module is disabled.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio 5.0.11 before 5.0.16 Broken Access Control via inventory_data.php

cna.title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 Authorization Bypass via pdfl Mode in lists_show.php

descriptions.value: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to export lists despite export restrictions by requesting mode=pdfl. The groups_roles_export check in modules/groups-roles/lists_show.php omits pdfl, which later runs the pdf export, letting users with list view rights download member lists as PDF files.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 Authorization Bypass via pdfl Mode in lists_show.php

cna.title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 IDOR via Forum Topic Update

descriptions.value: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in ForumService::saveTopic() that allows authenticated members to modify other users' forum topics. Attackers can replace the topic_uuid parameter in their own topic_save request, reusing their CSRF token, to overwrite the victim topic's title and first post.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 IDOR via Forum Topic Update

cna.title: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 Authentication Bypass via WebAuthn Credential Injection

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability where WebAuthn registration endpoints attach credentials to any account without authentication or challenge validation. Attackers can stage a victim username, submit a forged fmt=none attestation to register a passkey, then log in bypassing passwords and TOTP for account takeover.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 Authentication Bypass via WebAuthn Credential Injection

cna.title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Authorization Bypass via attachment.php Downloads

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in attachment.php that allows attackers to download attachments of restricted FAQs by bypassing per-record permission checks. Low-privileged users with the dlattachment right, or anonymous users when allowDownloadsForGuests is enabled, can request attachment IDs to retrieve confidential files from restricted FAQs.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Authorization Bypass via attachment.php Downloads

cna.title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 Missing Authorization Allows Superadmin Deletion via deleteUser API

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the deleteUser() API that allows authenticated non-superadmin users with delete_user permission to delete superadmin accounts. Attackers can send a DELETE request to /admin/api/user/delete with a superadmin's userId other than 1, removing administrative access and accountability.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 Missing Authorization Allows Superadmin Deletion via deleteUser API

cna.title: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta BOLA in FAQ Update via REST API

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/v3.1/faq/update endpoint, which checks only the global edit_faq permission and does not verify access to the target FAQ. Authenticated users with edit_faq permission can supply the ID of a restricted FAQ they cannot view to modify its content, bypass moderation, and change its publication state.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta BOLA in FAQ Update via REST API

cna.title: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 CSRF via /admin/api/update-database

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the POST /admin/api/update-database endpoint, which executes database migrations without validating a CSRF token. Attackers can lure a logged-in user with the CONFIGURATION_EDIT permission into submitting a crafted cross-site request, triggering migrations that may impact database integrity or availability.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 CSRF via /admin/api/update-database

cna.title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta CSRF in Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Admin API Index Operations

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the Elasticsearch and OpenSearch administration API endpoints, which do not validate a CSRF token for the create, drop, and import actions. Attackers can lure a user with CONFIGURATION_EDIT permission to a malicious page that triggers these actions, deleting search indexes, forcing re-indexing, or exhausting resources.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta CSRF in Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Admin API Index Operations

cna.title: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta IDOR Leaks TOTP Secret via /admin/api/user/data

descriptions.value: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /admin/api/user/data/{userId}, which returns any user's full faquserdata row, including the live TOTP secret, without a SuperAdmin or protected-target check. Delegated administrators with user-management rights can read a SuperAdmin's TOTP secret and generate valid codes to bypass two-factor authentication.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta IDOR Leaks TOTP Secret via /admin/api/user/data
